description: Defines the CloudStoreImplementation class which implements IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for cloud storage management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements cloud storage and configuration interfaces, manages notifications, and provides methods for setting, getting, and deleting stored values.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the account store.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the account store.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the account store within a specific scope and namespace.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and its TTL from the account store within a specific scope and namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the account store within a specific scope and namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the account store within a specific scope.
